title: KineticWorks
description: A server modpack with something for everyone.
body:
A Create-centered modpack built for flexible gameplay, whether you’re playing solo or occasionally with friends.

At its core, the pack focuses on intuitive automation and progression using Create, expanded by deeper tech systems like Applied Energistics 2, Mekanism, and Ender IO. You can build simple setups or scale into fully interconnected factories, depending on how far you want to push it.

Quality-of-life mods smooth out the experience without taking away the survival feeling. Exploration, building, and resource gathering still matter.

It works great alone, but also holds up in small groups where everyone can specialize a bit and share infrastructure when needed.
